subject: Dynamic box generation wont show any content in modules

messages.author: 8c80d5cd7a4e6600
messages.subject: Dynamic box generation wont show any content in modules
parts:
I have created some reproducible code to show the issue I am having. I created an app that is using modules and has a way for boxes to be created on the fly based on a number typed in a box above. The actual dynamic module/box part works (type 6 and 6 boxes appear below). However, nothing I put inside the wellPanel shows up in each box. Any idea how I can get around this and create unified content in each box?

app.R code...
source("test_modules.R")
library(shinydashboard)
library(shiny)




#### UI CODE ####
ui <- dashboardPage(skin = "blue",
  # define header
  dashboardHeader(
    title = "Test Dashboard",
    titleWidth = 300
  ),
 
  # define sidebar
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(id = "dashboard_menu",
                menuItem("Home", icon = icon("home"), tabName = "home"),
                menuItem("Test Build", icon = icon("cogs"), tabName = "build_test_main")
               
    )
  ),
 
  # define body
  dashboardBody(
   
    tabItems(
      tabItem(tabName = "home"


      ),
      ## Research Tools
      build_test_setUI(id = "build_test_main")
    )
  )
)
#### END UI CODE ####


#### SERVER CODE ####
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  ### Module Calls ###
  callModule(build_test_set, id = "build_test_main")
}
#### END SERVER CODE ####




#### FINAL OUTPUT FUNCTION ####
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
#### END FINAL OUTPUT FUNCTION ####

test_modules.R code...
create_test_shinyUI <- function(id, title_use) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  box(
    width = 12,
    title = title_use,
    solidHeader = TRUE,
    wellPanel(
      fluidRow(
        column(12,
               uiOutput(ns("param_selection_use_menu"))
        )
      )
    )
  )
}


create_test_shiny <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$param_selection_use_menu <- renderUI({
    ns <- session$ns
   
    selectInput(ns("param_selection_use"), label = "Param 1", choices = setNames(c("A","B"), c("a", "b")))
  })
}






build_test_setUI <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
 
  tabItem(tabName = id,
          fluidRow(
            column(12,
                   box(
                     width = 12,
                     title = "General Setup",
                     solidHeader = TRUE,
                     wellPanel(
                       fluidRow(
                         column(1,
                                br()    
                         ),
                         column(3,
                                uiOutput(ns("test_building_setup_menu"))    
                         ),
                         column(3,
                                br()
                         ),
                         column(3,
                                br()  
                         )
                       )
                     )
                   )      
            )
          ),
          fluidRow(
            column(12,
                   uiOutput(ns("test_parameters_master"))
            )
          )
  )
}




build_test_set <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$test_building_setup_menu <- renderUI({
    ns <- session$ns
    numericInput(ns("test_building_setup"), label = "Amount of Tests", value = 4, min = 1, max = 10, step = 1)
  })
 
  output$test_parameters_master <- renderUI({
    req(input$test_building_setup)
   
    lapply(1:(as.numeric(input$test_building_setup)), FUN = function(i) {
      create_test_shinyUI(paste0("test_setup_", i), paste("Test", i))
    })
  })
 
  observe({
    req(input$test_building_setup)
    sapply(1:(as.numeric(input$test_building_setup)), function(i) {
      callModule(create_test_shiny, paste0("test_setup_", i))
    })
  })
}

messages.author: d6ebe55625e8e5a2
messages.subject: Re: Dynamic box generation wont show any content in modules
parts:
You forgot to call ns() on the inner module.

Change the build_test_set function to this (difference highlighted)

ns <- session$ns   # move this to the top level
  output$test_building_setup_menu <- renderUI({

numericInput(ns("test_building_setup"), label = "Amount of Tests", value = 4, min = 1, max = 10, step = 1)
  })
  
  output$test_parameters_master <- renderUI({
    req(input$test_building_setup)
    
    lapply(1:(as.numeric(input$test_building_setup)), FUN = function(i) {
create_test_shinyUI(ns(paste0("test_setup_", i)), paste("Test", i))  # call ns() here

})
  })
  
  observe({
    req(input$test_building_setup)
    sapply(1:(as.numeric(input$test_building_setup)), function(i) {
      callModule(create_test_shiny, paste0("test_setup_", i))
    })
  })
}

Then everything should work fine. When nesting modules, you cannot forget to call ns() on the id param when you call the inner function's UI component: https://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/modules.html#nesting-modules
